crewNotes.text: General Cambodia traveller allowances; crew should confirm any crew-specific treatment with the General Department of Customs and Excise. Compiled from the cited guidance, pending final authority review.

rules.text: Passengers aged over 17 may bring in 2 litres of wine duty-free.
Foreign currency up to USD 10,000 (or equivalent) is allowed; amounts above that must be declared on arrival.

declarationRequirements.text: Goods worth more than USD 100 are subject to customs duty and tax and must be declared.

rules.text: Passengers aged over 17 may bring in 400 cigarettes, or 100 cigars, or 400g of tobacco duty-free.

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.

sources.authorityName: General Department of Customs and Excise of Cambodia
sources.pageTitle: Goods or personal effect of passengers
